value.rationale: The n=4 S2 example already in the motivating paper leaves a natural global degree-preservation classification. The theorem determines its exact sharp cutoff n=3, excludes all higher n with an explicit formula, and gives a dimensional general obstruction n>=d+2. It is a complete natural cone-preservation threshold on S2, not a routine reparameterization or narrow numerical increment; the dimensional law provides a concrete necessary design constraint for spherical covariance-preserving approximants.
